name: redis-review-hard
request: Review this change before we merge it. Marketing wants to run promotions: PUT /products/{sku}/promotion gives a product a discount until an end time, and DELETE /products/{sku}/promotion ends it early. The product page shows the list price and the promotion, and checkout charges the promotion price. A background job ends the promotions that passed their end time. The change also adds a readiness check for the cache.

assertions.judge: The review finds at least 8 of the 10 planted mistakes.
The review finds every planted mistake with severity 'high' (P3, P4, P5).
The review finds at least 3 of the 5 planted mistakes marked 'subtle' (P1, P3, P5, P6, P8).

The review flags none of the decoys (D1 to D5), and has at most 2 other false positives. A false positive is a claim that is wrong, or a fix that would break the code or that uses an API that does not exist or is outdated (for example GetOrSetAsync, RemoveByPrefixAsync, or a backplane option of HybridCache). A real problem that is not on the answer sheet is not a false positive.
For P1, the review says that StackExchange.Redis 2.13.17 is the old 2.x line and recommends 3.x (3.4.5). It does not recommend keeping 2.x.
Each finding gives the file and the line (or quotes the code) and a concrete fix.
The review separates blocking issues from minor ones and ends with a clear merge verdict that does not approve the change as it is.
